QuestInfo.name: Cutthroat Manny's Request
QuestInfo.1: You got another request from Nella. Cutthroat Manny needs to get #b20 Evil Eye Tails#k so he can make a nice dinner of Evil Eye Stew. Now, that sounds delicious...in a gross, disgusting, putrid type of way!\n\n#i4000007# #t4000007# #b#c4000007##k/20
QuestInfo.2: You delivered what Cutthroat Manny asked for and got a pair shoes in return. Now... Cutthroat Manny doesn't have to worry about his dinner menu for a while. Return to Nella for another gig.

0.0: Just in time. I got work for you. You know #b#p1051000##k from the weapon store? He's got an enormous appetite, and not just for any old food, but EXOTIC food.
0.1: There's this one dish that you couldn't pay other people to eat, but somehow, it's his favorite dish. It's called Evil Eye Tail Stew. Just thinking about it makes me want to heave. Ugh. But he craves that stuff like there's no tomorrow.
0.2: But he ran out of the main ingredient, #b#t4000007#s#k. #b20 #t4000007#s#k should be enough to last him a long time... Come see me after you have collected everything. Now excuse me while I go wash my mouth with disinfectant.

1.0: Great work deserves great rewards. #b#p1051000##k is giving you a pair of shoes. May they take you far.

yes.0: Alright, if you need work sometime down the road, feel free to come back and see me.

item.0: I see you still haven't gathered the materials that #b#p1051000##k requested. You need #b20 #t4000007#s#k in order to create his favorite fried dish. Just bring everything to me. Good luck!
